name: GET /api/consents/:receipt_id - Is the consent this was captured under still valid
description: The state of ONE receipt by id, the AUDIT question: is the specific consent a recording or an export was captured under still good? POST /api/consents/check asks a different, POLICY question (is there any active consent for the four-tuple), and the two come apart when a basis is revoked and a new consent granted later. The tenant comes from the token and is applied in SQL. 200 { success, data: { receipt_id, person_id, purpose_id, processor, jurisdiction, app_id, granted_at, expires_at, revoked_at, active, revoked, expired } }, where active is true only when not revoked and not expired. Errors: 404 for a receipt in another tenant, an unknown id or a non-uuid (never 403, and never 500 for a malformed id, because a distinguishable answer would itself disclose that the receipt exists); 403 for a token without a tenant; 401 for no token.

testCases.name: Read the state of the receipt just granted
404 (not 500) - a non-uuid id never reaches the database

errorCases.when: unknown id, non-uuid id, or a receipt in another tenant

errorCases.message: This token carries no tenant, so no receipt scope can be derived
